thread:
Samir: Heads-up — ACME Retail pilot showing a ~40% drop in API usage after week 2. They still log in but calls per user fell off. Pilot started two weeks ago. Need a quick save plan before renewal talk.
Priya: Thanks, Samir. Quick question — do we have their onboarding checklist completion? I pulled the dashboard: 60% complete, missing webhook setup and prompt templates.
Samir: Correct. CSM notes say engineering didn't finish the webhook wiring and they didn't adopt the prompt recipes. Also flagged cost sensitivity — might ask to downgrade to Starter tier.
Jules: Suggest 2-track approach: (A) Enablement sprint: 2x short calls (CS + SE pairing), supply 3 battle-tested prompt templates + sample webhook handler. (B) Downgrade-swap fallback: preserve embeddings, prorated credits, re-onboard offer. Push for (A) first.
Eloise: I'll own the enablement sprint. Can we offer a 7-day free usage burst and a one-pager playbook? @Priya can you draft the one-pager and a 15-min screen recording? :thumbsup:
Priya: On it. Drafting the one-pager + 3 prompt recipes now. Will also prep a minimal webhook debug checklist and ping platform-eng for a quick pairing session. ETA EOD.
Samir: I'll create a renewal-risk ticket (medium-high) and set a canary metric: weekly active calls -> +30% within 7 days post-sprint. If not met, trigger downgrade offer.
Jules: For the downgrade-swap path, recommend we: keep embeddings storage intact for 30 days, prorate billing, offer a one-off re-onboard credit, and schedule a re-engagement in 30 days. Need finance sign-off on credits.
Eloise: I'll escalate to finance and confirm by tomorrow. Meanwhile I scheduled a customer alignment call: Tue 10:00 AM PT and an engineer pairing slot: Thu 2:00 PM PT.
Priya: Creating a short internal runbook for the sprint. Initial checklist below:
```
- Pre-call: verify webhook endpoint reachable (curl + TLS)
- Pre-call: import prompt templates into their workspace
- Pairing: reproduce sample request, confirm 95th pct latency < target, demo batching knob
- Post-call: enable 7-day free burst, monitor WAU and token usage, weekly snapshot
- If < +30% WAU in 7d -> offer downgrade-swap + re-onboard credit
```
Samir: Adding the runbook to the ticket and tagging @finance in the notes. cs-bot: assigned risk=medium-high, owner=Eloise.
cs-bot: Automated note — risk flag created, notify: #renewals and #finance.
Eloise: I'll send the one-pager + recording link to the customer after the Tue call. Priya, can you DM the SE contact for pairing?
Priya: Yep, pinging now.
Jules: If enablement goes well, let's document success signals so we can lift the risk flag automatically (metrics -> 30% WAU increase OR 3+ active projects).
Samir: Agreed. I'll add those signals to the ticket and set a 14-day follow-up cadence. Thanks team — small, focused sprint here should buy time and reduce churn risk.
Eloise: Agree — leaning on the pairing + trial burst. Will update thread after Tue call. :rocket:
